_doc: Employees (GDD 4.7, H4; contract docs/contratos/h4_empleados.md). Catalog.employees. Durations in game days (1 year = 8 days, D1(b)). Probabilities per day in [0, 1]. Marked [balance] in the GDD: adjusted with bots.
_ranks_doc: 4.7.2. wage = gold per day, paid at dawn (category wages). efficiency = share of a normal worker's output (4.7.2: at least 1 unit per cycle). speed = multiplier of the cycle speed (duration / speed, 4.4.1). promote_after_days = days worked in this rank before the promotion can be offered; promote_min_loyalty = loyalty must be >= this (GDD: > 50 and > 70). requires_upgrade: building upgrade needed to hire or promote into this rank (GDD: Maestro needs 'Taller de maestro'; '' until the upgrade tree exists in H5 [provisional]). availability: how common it is in the town's population (descriptive).
_roles_doc: 4.7.4: the task of each employee. A station id of the building (only that kind of station, BUG-023) or 'any' (wherever needed). default_role = the role of a new hire [provisional].
_loyalty_doc: 4.7.3. start = loyalty of a new hire [provisional: GDD 06 example]. Changes: wage_paid per day paid on time, wage_unpaid per day unpaid after the grace, bonus (bonus_gold, 4.7.3 'Bonus manual (+5 oro)'), promotion_accepted, promotion_refused, building_damaged per day; facade_upgrade and dining_upgrade arrive with H5.
_bands_doc: 4.7.3 consequences by loyalty, checked at dawn, the first band whose [min, max] holds the loyalty. efficiency_mult multiplies the rank's efficiency (GDD: -20 % at 40-69; also below 40 [provisional]). rumor_reputation: reputation of the employer family per day in the band [provisional: the GDD does not say how often]. quit_chance / theft_chance: per day. theft: 1-3 units of the most valuable product of the building storage, then the thief flees (no_rehire_days). security_divisor: Security branch (H5) divides the theft chance.
_wages_doc: 4.7.3 real wages: at dawn from the employer family's gold. Without gold: notice, grace_days without penalty, then loyalty wage_unpaid and reputation unpaid_reputation per day.
_fire_doc: 4.7.3: the fired employee leaves at the end of the day; if their loyalty was > reputation_loyalty_over, the employer family loses `reputation`.
_hire_doc: 4.7.1: a hire starts working the next day at dawn (start_day = day + start_after_days); the family must be able to pay one day's wage when hiring.
_schedule_doc: 4.1 and 4.11.2: employees leave home at the start of `leave_home_phase` with a delay drawn per employee and day in leave_home_delay_minutes, work in work_phases (Production.may_work refuses outside them: off_hours, or night_rest at night), and go home at the start of go_home_phase. Never at night.
